title: Figures 11-12: Polylactic acid molecular model and PLA anti-adhesion barrier illustration
description: A rendered space-filling molecular model in green, white and red is captioned "Figure 11. Structure of Polylactic Acid (a Biodegradable Polymer)". Below, an artist's illustration headed "The Clear Choice" shows a hand placing a clear PLA sheet over an exposed heart in an open chest, with the tagline "Protection in case there is a re-operation..." and caption "Figure 12. Biodegradable PLA as an Antiadhesion Barrier after Open-Heart Surgery".
